description: This file contains React/JavaScript functions for user dashboard actions such as logout, fetching user data and orders, updating personal info, and changing password.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Removes user-related data from local storage and redirects to home page.

methods.name: fetchData
methods.description: Fetches user details by ID and updates state via dispatch.

methods.name: fetchOrderByUser
methods.description: Fetches user orders and updates state via dispatch.

methods.name: updatePersonalInformationAction
methods.description: Updates user's personal information and refreshes user data.

methods.name: handleChangePassword
methods.description: Handles password change process with validation and API call.
